title: Quasi-coherent derived categories have direct sums
statement: For every quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme X [def-pc-scheme], the derived category D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] of complexes of O_X-modules with quasi-coherent cohomology has all set-indexed direct sums.
